description: This file defines metrics and related functions for validation admission policies in Kubernetes, including Prometheus metric registration, error type definitions, and metric observation methods.

classes.name: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyMetrics
classes.description: Struct holding Prometheus metrics counters and histograms for validation admission policies.

methods.name: newValidationAdmissionMetrics
methods.description: Initializes and registers Prometheus metrics for validation admission checks and latency.

methods.name: ObserveAdmission
methods.description: Records a successful validation admission metric with elapsed time and labels.

methods.name: ObserveRejection
methods.description: Records a validation rejection metric with elapsed time and labels.

methods.name: ObserveAudit
methods.description: Records an audit event for validation failure with elapsed time and labels.

methods.name: ObserveWarn
methods.description: Records a warning event for validation failure with elapsed time and labels.
